Founder.cardIntro: Engineer and investor since 2019, based in Bali since 2023, I apply the same rigor in Bali as I would in France.
Founder.cardP1: Living on site, I discovered a particularly favorable framework for investing as a foreigner. I spent months studying the rules and meeting hundreds of real estate professionals, before building a solid and reliable project team.
Founder.cardP2: I'm the kind of person who reads the fine print and weighs several scenarios before deciding. In Bali, I applied the same standard.
Founder.cardP3: Very quickly, my circle of investors wanted in. We launched a first project of 9 villas, now rented out. Since then, 19 more villas have been built. That's how Sora Immobilier was born, with the same rigor at every step.

Faq.title: What you want to know before investing.

items.q: Do I need to be physically present in Bali?
items.a: No. Sora handles operational and technical oversight on site, with regular updates for investors based in Europe.

items.q: How does the flow of capital work?
items.a: The process happens in stages: reservation, acquisition or construction, then delivery. Payments are tied to actual project progress and planned milestones.

items.q: How do taxation and income work?
items.a: Each setup depends on your situation, the structure chosen and your wealth goals. This is reviewed before any investment decision.

items.q: What happens if I want to exit the investment?
items.a: You remain the owner under the terms of the structure chosen. In case of arbitration or sale, Sora can support the next steps.
Co-investment gives access to a project with a lower entry ticket. Full ownership suits those who want to control the asset and its use.

items.q: How do I know if Bali fits my profile?
items.a: The simplest way is to talk through your situation, investment horizon and constraints. The 30-minute call exists precisely to clarify this.

Cta.title: Check whether Bali makes sense for your profile.
Cta.body1: During the call, Gabriel reviews your situation, the amount you're considering, your investment horizon and the legal points to clarify before sending you the file.
Cta.body2: The goal isn't to sell you Bali at all costs, but to check whether the setup, entry ticket and timeline genuinely match your situation.
Cta.footnote: Free call with a response within 24h, your information stays confidential.
